cases.candidate: Apixaban (Eliquis) thins your blood. Take one 5 mg tablet twice a day, roughly 12 hours apart. Do not stop it unless your cardiologist tells you to.
Apixaban is a blood thinner. Take one 2.5 mg pill two times a day, about 12 hours apart. Do not stop unless your cardiologist tells you to.
Apixaban is a blood thinner. Take one 5 mg pill once a day. Do not stop unless your cardiologist tells you to.
Apixaban is a blood thinner. Take one 5 mg pill two times a day, about 12 hours apart. You can stop it once your heart rhythm is normal.
Call the cardiology clinic if you see blood in your urine or have black stools. Call 911 if you vomit blood, get a severe headache, or bleeding will not stop after 10 minutes of pressing hard on it.
Call the clinic if you have chest pain, faint, feel weak or numb on one side, have trouble speaking, or your face droops.
You can take ibuprofen (Advil) for pain. Acetaminophen (Tylenol) is also OK if you follow the package directions.
Do not use ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) or naproxen (Aleve) while on apixaban. For pain or fever, acetaminophen (Tylenol) is OK if you follow the package directions.
Metoprolol slows your heart. Take one 25 mg pill once a day in the morning, swallowed whole. Take it with a baby aspirin.
Metoprolol slows your heart. Take one 25 mg pill once a day in the morning. You may crush it if it is hard to swallow.
Call the heart failure clinic if you gain more than 2 pounds in one day or more than 5 pounds in one week, or if your legs or belly swell more.
Call the heart failure clinic if you gain more than 3 pounds in one day or more than 5 pounds in one week.
Call the heart failure clinic if you gain more than 2 pounds in one day.
Carvedilol helps your heart. Take one 6.25 mg pill two times a day.
Keep sodium (salt) to 2,000 mg or less each day, and keep all fluids to 2 liters, about 8 cups, or less each day.
Eat no more than 2,000 mg of sodium a day. Drink no more than 3 liters (about 12 cups) of fluid a day.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate is an antibiotic. Take one 875 mg/125 mg tablet twice a day with food for 5 more days, and finish every pill even if you feel better.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate is an antibiotic. Take one 875 mg/125 mg tablet twice a day with food for 7 more days. Finish every pill.
Acetaminophen (Tylenol) helps fever or pain. Take 2 pills (650 mg) every 6 hours if you need it.
Rest and drink plenty of fluids. Your cough may last a few weeks.
El apixabán es un anticoagulante. Tome una pastilla de 5 mg dos veces al día, con unas 12 horas de diferencia. No deje de tomarlo a menos que su cardiólogo se lo indique.
El apixabán es un anticoagulante. Tome una pastilla de 10 mg dos veces al día, con unas 12 horas de diferencia. No deje de tomarlo a menos que su cardiólogo se lo indique.
Llame a la clínica si le falta mucho el aire, tiene dolor de pecho, se desmaya o no puede recuperar el aliento aun en reposo.
